title: Income Tax: changes to the definition of serious ill health lump sums and medical evidence requirements
text:
This measure changes the test for qualifying for a serious ill health lump sum where a pension scheme member can reasonably be expected to live for less than 12 months.

 It also allows supporting medical evidence to be provided by a member’s medical practitioner outside the UK if either:

 • the member lives in the same country as the medical practitioner

 • the pension scheme is established in that country
